description: Who speaks which npc_text. The C++ scripts pick gossip texts at runtime (SendGossipMenu(textId, ...)) without a gossip_menu link, so the AI VoiceOver generator cannot find these texts through the database. Every npc_text id the module sends has to be listed here exactly once per speaking NPC. A text may be listed for several NPCs. 'unused' also lists the default gossip greetings: they are shown on right-click but deliberately not voiced, so only the conversation pages the scripts send are heard. Check coverage with: python main.py check-gossip-manifest (AI_VoiceOver_Generator).
